category: hosted CI pipeline engine with usage-based pricing and a monthly plan minimum

confidence_note: all values are quoted from the first-party pricing page read on 2026-11-19. The engine itself is open source and can run locally; this record is for the hosted Dagger Cloud service and its pricing. There is no standing free hosted tier on the page.

endpoint: unverified: no public API endpoint stated on the pages read
tooling: pipelines as code in an SDK, executed as standard OCI containers with content-addressed caching
chaining: a pipeline defined in code runs in containers on Dagger Cloud, with cache hits billed at a fifth of the rate of new work

pipeline inputs cost USD 0.025 per GB and outputs USD 0.10 per GB for new work, five times less for repeat work
the plan price or the usage bill is charged, whichever is higher; Starter is USD 20 a month and Scale USD 200 a month

binding_note: there is no free hosted plan: the monthly minimum applies even when usage is below it, so the Starter price binds a reader with no budget
